data.disjointness: all heldout public feature hashes disjoint from train/dev and AF16/17 evaluated heldouts
data.heldout_logical_templates: same AF-17 serial_shortcut, dual_fallback, contingent_goal structures; new physical permutations only
data.old_train_dev: exact original AF-17 input cases and sampled states
data.probe_pairs: dual_fallback AND fixed logical graph at depths3,4,5; initial fact0 toggles reachability, all other public features fixed
data.probe_scope: mechanistic structural diagnostic; no measured generalization claim for paired cases
data.split_manifest: fresh_manifest.json generated and committed before training

evaluation.eligibility: l2_cap16, l6_cap16 and l8_cap16 each require >=0.65 provable-goal proof success separately on train and dev, per seed
evaluation.exact_host: each enabled rule has all premises proved and adds a new head; shortest proof budget from independent physical-incidence BFS + 1; unprovable goals get two actions
evaluation.gate_policy: negative, ineligible and inconclusive seeds retained; green engineering checks do not change scientific outcome
evaluation.independent_audit: independent physical-graph BFS for each episode and sampled Bellman label; complete proof/logit row roster, source hashes, Torch/NumPy equality, sampled forward replay, paired-cone numerical checks; original source contract
evaluation.primary: For each eligible seed on BOTH held_depth4/held_depth5, l6_cap16 and l8_cap16 each >= l2_cap16+0.05 proof success, each >=0.70 absolute, 0 false host accepted proofs, each early STOP rate <= l2_cap16 +0.02. Any eligible required failure => FAIL, all four eligible passes => PASS, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluation.scientific_scope: finite structured AND/OR Horn DAG policy and new physical layouts, not independent Lean theorem generation or general unseen logical operators
evaluation.secondary: l2_cap10 vs l2_cap16 cost collision and end-to-end success; l4_cap16 intermediate depth; STOP, reachability and distance logit difference for paired causal-cone probes

failure_policy: preserve failed engineering attempts, freeze source before any scored test; new scientific changes require separate AF-19 registration; keep PR draft until review and merge authorization

formal.Lean: CausalCone.lean proves arithmetic cost-cap separation and cone-radius exclusion corollary; the full TypedLoop graph-locality argument is in README and tested against actual weights
formal.runtime: local Python 3.13 Torch 2.10 CPU; hosted Python 3.12 Torch2.5.1 CPU and Lean4.19 when runners available

model.action: raw rule/STOP logits; host masks illegal rules and checks every inference independently
model.new_class: SweepPolicy varies only self.loops; 5268 learned parameters identical across conditions
model.source: unchanged source-hash pinned AF-17 BellmanTypedPolicy and original TypedLoop cell
model.state_input: physical graph, initial facts, host-proved atom bits, host legal-action mask; no oracle truth/cost/reachability as input

ownership.instruction: AF-01 through AF-17 source, evidence and scientific verdicts remain unchanged

question: Does increasing native-cell recurrence from 2 to 4/6/8 calls make the goal STOP head sensitive to distant facts and improve host-sound proof-search success on new depth-4/5 graph layouts? How much does resolving the cap10 cost collision change performance at fixed L=2?
title: Recurrent STOP causal-cone depth sweep and uncapped finite Bellman targets

training.cap10_control: same 2-loop architecture, labels clipped to 10, exposes cost-ranking collision on valid 10/11-fire proofs
training.cap16: maximum possible shortest Horn proof <= number of initially unproved atoms <=15; 16 therefore strictly separates any successful proof cost from unreachable/early STOP target
training.checkpoint: fixed final update, source/checkpoint SHA and independent named-array .npz export for every seed/config
training.no_heldout_fit: train only from train cases; dev only for qualification; no heldout-selected model or optimization changes
training.objective: AF17 identical shortest-action CE +0.65 (STOP calibration BCE+0.25 reach BCE) +0.55 (Q legal-logit Huber +0.5 distance Huber). Bellman target cap changes only cost numeric values, not legal actions, labels or model features.
training.real_compute: more loops consume proportionally more native forward and backward compute; comparisons are step/input matched, not FLOP matched
training.rng: identical seeded initialization, sampled train states and optimizer step count per seed; 16 AF-15 legacy and 16 AF-16 new-composition states per batch
